title: Why bilona ghee costs more
caption:
Why does bilona ghee cost 3x more than regular ghee? 🧈

It starts with curd, not cream. The curd is hand-churned into makkhan and slow-heated into ghee. It takes about 25–30 litres of milk to make just 1 kg.

Our A2 Bilona Cow Ghee is made from desi cow milk the traditional way.
